commandTemplates.inventory: gcloud scheduler jobs list --project routespark-1f47d --location us-central1 --format=json
commandTemplates.describe: gcloud scheduler jobs describe <exact-job-id> --project routespark-1f47d --location us-central1 --format=json
commandTemplates.pause: gcloud scheduler jobs pause <exact-job-id> --project routespark-1f47d --location us-central1
commandTemplates.resume: gcloud scheduler jobs resume <exact-job-id> --project routespark-1f47d --location us-central1

testNotification.deny: no mutation while the observed function and project policies remain non-public; preflight must abort if allUsers invoker appears
testNotification.negativeTest: POST an unauthenticated callable envelope to the exact HTTPS URL and require HTTP 403 before any body handler log or Expo effect
testNotification.rollback: restore the exact preflight IAM policy, which currently has no public invoker binding

updatePCFContainerCounts.denyCommand: gcloud functions remove-iam-policy-binding updatePCFContainerCounts --project routespark-1f47d --region us-central1 --member allUsers --role roles/cloudfunctions.invoker --quiet
updatePCFContainerCounts.readBackCommand: gcloud functions get-iam-policy updatePCFContainerCounts --project routespark-1f47d --region us-central1 --format=json
updatePCFContainerCounts.negativeTest: POST an unauthenticated callable envelope to the exact HTTPS URL and require HTTP 403 before any body handler log or Firestore/Storage effect
updatePCFContainerCounts.rollbackCommand: gcloud functions add-iam-policy-binding updatePCFContainerCounts --project routespark-1f47d --region us-central1 --member allUsers --role roles/cloudfunctions.invoker --quiet

executionRules: re-census all scheduler jobs and both callable IAM policies immediately before any fence
record exact pre-state and etag before mutation
pause or deny only the named exact target; never use a wildcard or bulk command
wait the deployed timeout plus transport margin and prove no in-flight work before final delta
perform the negative test only inside the signed rollout window
restore from the captured pre-state and independently read it back on abort
